case: SDK 1.13 cn-standard WORKS notice (SVK, open procedure): a construction contract whose classification spans 19 CPV codes across construction, electrical equipment and maintenance, including one 72* IT code (72267200). The case where a single in-sector code appears on a contract an IT supplier would never bid, so contract-nature exclusion — not CPV scoring — has to be what settles it.
